summary_json.self_sha256: omitted because an embedded self-hash would be recursive; hash the final file externally

gas_eos_and_adiabat.adiabatic_reference: p/p0=(Vg/Vg0)^(-gamma), evaluated at each same-mesh observed raw Vg/Vg0; pressure departure percent=(measured ratio/reference - 1)*100; sensitivity reference, not fitted closure.

methods_and_limits.binary_difference: The baseline and refined case binaries differ (original versus lean audit build); fvOptions, fvSchemes, fvSolution, and both thermo dictionaries are byte-identical. The refined controlDict adds i4fFullPressureAudit=false and changes only the operational endTime/stopAt values before .1 s. The lean binary disables expensive read-only audit work only; this comparison remains exploratory, not formal convergence evidence.
methods_and_limits.gas_mass_temperature: rho_g=p/(R*T.air), then signed gas mass=(1-alpha)*rho_g*V and mass-weighted T.air; negative gas-phase weights caused by alpha>1 are reported rather than clipped.
methods_and_limits.gas_pressure: TankZone gas-volume weighted absolute p with signed raw (1-alpha)V weights; headspace-only p is reported separately.
methods_and_limits.mixed_cells: 0.01 < raw alpha.water < 0.99; mixed-cell gas volume/mass shares are relative to signed raw tank gas inventories.
methods_and_limits.native_geometry: Each case uses its own binary native C, cellVolume, cellZones, and bijective 10-rank cellProcAddressing map.
methods_and_limits.scope: At most .10 s is a startup prefix with two mesh snapshots; no convergence order, thermal closure, or apparatus validation claim.
methods_and_limits.seat_flux: Read existing native surfaceFieldValue sum(alphaPhi0.water) on oriented valveSeat faceZones at the matched scalar row time; row offset is preserved; sampled planes are not used.
methods_and_limits.seat_flux_time_qualification: At .050021166664, the restart checkpoint has no corresponding function-object row; first available subsequent row is retained as an unmatched row and no .05 seat flux is substituted. Both cases have exact matched seat flux rows at .100021166664.
methods_and_limits.water_drawdown: Raw sum(alpha.water*V) in each native tankZone relative to that mesh's own t=0; signed excursions remain included.

normalization: Each mesh and tank uses its own true native processor10/0 cold initial alpha.water, p and T.air fields. The .05 restart field is never substituted for t=0.
objective: Extend the .05 s comparison through available exact common native checkpoints; report raw phase-fraction bounds without clipping.
phase_fraction_method: All reductions use raw mapped alpha.water with no clipping; gas fraction is raw 1-alpha.water. Lower/upper excursions and their signed phase volumes/EOS masses are reported separately and remain in the normalized inventory reductions. Strict alpha<0 or alpha>1 counts include values at floating-point roundoff; nested ±1e-12 and ±1e-8 excursion summaries distinguish near-bound noise from material local undershoot/overshoot.

time_join.method: Numeric join on each processor snapshot uniform/time; no field interpolation/extrapolation; max pairwise time mismatch 1e-10 s.

publication_transform.reason: External publication manifest records the actual final payload size/hash. All physical observables and input hashes are unchanged; original analysis is preserved.
